name: agent-kitchen
description: The kitchen that designs agent artifacts, cut by situation: new-skill (build one, and pick the surface it belongs on), improve-skill (fix one that isn't working, or work new material into it), grill-skill (run one against a real prompt and iterate), ingest (ground a design in sources first), and harness-audit (audit the whole setup). The reusable design layer; the skills it produces live in the skills plugin.
